title: Failure-fingerprint normalizer: strip per-cycle path/attempt variance from abort-reason strings
problem: PR #442 routes phase abort reasons into FailReasons (feeding failure fingerprints). normalizeReasonForFingerprint strips only narrative=<verdict> tokens and go-test decimal durations; path-bearing abort strings (per-cycle workspace/worktree paths in driver/artifact errors) and the ship-recovery 'attempt %d/%d' (denominator shifts with fleet width) split fingerprints for the same defect class, blinding the identical-fingerprint breaker.
fix: Extend normalizeReasonForFingerprint (core/failure_digest.go): normalize .evolve/runs/cycle-N and worktree lane paths to stable tokens; normalize 'attempt N/M' to 'attempt N/M'-invariant form. Table-driven tests with the real abort shapes (launch refusal, artifact timeout, all-families-exhausted).
acceptance: Two abort reasons differing only by cycle-numbered paths or attempt denominators fingerprint identically; distinct classes stay distinct; existing normalization pins untouched.
